description: Perform a data quality review for Kailahun District. Using the DHIS2 Data Quality app: (1) Run an outlier detection analysis for Kailahun District (including sub-units) for the period Jan 2022 to Dec 2023. Use the Z-score algorithm with a 3.0 threshold. Select any data sets containing health data (e.g., Child Health, Mortality, or Malaria). (2) In the results, identify and flag at least 3 suspicious values for follow-up (click the star icon). (3) Export the outlier results list to a file in /home/ga/Downloads/. (4) Create a summary report at /home/ga/Desktop/kailahun_data_quality_report.txt describing 2-3 specific outliers found (facility, data element, value) and your recommendations.
